description: This file defines a Java class EmailServices that provides various static methods for sending emails within the OFBiz framework. It includes functions for composing emails with attachments, rendering email bodies from screens or URLs, handling failures, and managing email content types. The class interacts with JavaMail APIs, OFBiz utilities, and other framework components to facilitate email communications, including advanced features like PDF attachments and multi-part messages.

classes.name: EmailServices.StringDataSource
classes.description: In-memory data source for String content to be used as email attachments.

methods.name: StringDataSource
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the data source with string content and content type.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the data source.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to read the data content.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a fixed name identifier for the data source.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException as the data source is read-only.

classes.name: EmailServices.ByteArrayDataSource
classes.description: In-memory data source for byte array content used for email attachments.

methods.name: ByteArrayDataSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the data source with byte array and content type.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the data source.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to read the byte array content.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a fixed name identifier for the data source.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Throws IOException since the data source is read-only.

methods.name: sendMail
methods.description: Main method to send an email with support for attachments, multiple recipients, and various configurations. Uses JavaMail API to construct and transmit the email message.

methods.name: sendMailFromUrl
methods.description: Fetches email body content from a specified URL and sends an email using the sendMail method.

methods.name: sendMailFromScreen
methods.description: Generates email body content from a screen rendering defined in OFBiz, supports attachments, and sends the email.

methods.name: sendMailHiddenInLogFromScreen
methods.description: Similar to sendMailFromScreen but with sensitive details hidden in logs.

methods.name: sendFailureNotification
methods.description: Notifies designated recipients about failed email delivery attempts, including failed addresses and original message content.
